title: broadcast entity_updated
description: Entity placement change (PUT /api/areas/{area_id}/entities/{entity_id}). Sent to admin sessions, the integration and every paired app that may read the area (authz read scope: active area in the app's list); apps reload the area with get_area. Never sent to apps outside the area's scope.

changed.description: Hint which fields changed (e.g. ["tile"], ["display_name", "tile"]). Absent = unknown. Apps reload the area either way.
